applicability.observation_condition: Exception raised indicating missing required positional argument for message payload when attempting to instantiate or invoke checksum calculation utility
Exception raised indicating missing required positional argument for message payload when attempting to instantiate or invoke checksum calculation utility

projection.guidance: When invoking checksum utilities for message integrity verification in low-level communication protocols, ensure that the message payload argument is provided to the checksum constructor or calculation method. The checksum utility requires the message data as a mandatory positional argument to compute the cyclic redundancy check value used for validating packet integrity in the robot communication layer.
